title: OperationalEvent
description: A time window with a class, a severity and a confidence. Event definition is the most fragile part of the project; H1 is deliberately constructed not to depend on it. Classes are reused from UAV-SEAD and from the diagnostic analysers already in flight-review-rs, not invented here.

event_class.description: Vocabulary term. The vocabulary and its origin are recorded in event_class_vocabulary.

event_class_vocabulary.description: e.g. uav_sead, flight_review_rs_analyser. Null only for an explicitly project-local class, which must be justified.

method.description: How the event was determined. Expert annotation and derived detection are never conflated.
